About the Role:

Camunda is hiring a Senior Manager, QA Engineering to lead the end-to-end QA strategy for Camunda 8 — elevating quality governance with rigorous quality gates, outcome-driven automation, and strategic reporting that guides roadmap and release decisions. They will manage two teams (functional and reliability) comprising 12 ICs, a principal engineer, and a manager; evolve the structure for scale; and ensure comprehensive coverage across business users, developers, and admins/operators in Kubernetes, cloud, and bare-metal environments. This first-of-its-kind role reports directly to the VP of Engineering.

  •  Own and drive the end-to-end QA strategy for Camunda 8, establishing quality gates and cross-team accountability.

  • Partner with principal engineering to mature reliability, performance, and resilience testing.

  • Guide automation strategy and QA processes to enable teams to deliver high-quality outcomes efficiently.

  • Develop actionable quality metrics, dashboards, and reports that inform leadership and roadmap decisions.

  • Lead and scale QA teams — managers, principal engineers, and ICs — evolving structure for maximum impact.

  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, product, UX, documentation, field) to embed quality across the organization.

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Proven track record leading QA in engineering organizations of 100–500 people, with measurable impact.

  • Ability to define and implement end-to-end QA strategy, quality gates, and data-informed decision-making across multiple teams.

  • Comfort staying connected to hands-on QA execution while leading strategically.

  • Experience leveling up QA for complex technical products, including developer/admin persona coverage and high-load, performance, resilience testing.

  • Skill aligning engineering, product, UX, documentation, and field teams around shared quality goals.

  • Enterprise software / workflow automation background.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes, cloud, microservices, and related operational challenges.

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, TestRail, or CI/CD-integrated testing environments.

  • Chaos engineering or advanced reliability/performance benchmarking experience.

  • Proven ability to drive cultural change in QA.

jobs.title: VP, Growth
jobs.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.

Join our Talent Pool

Not quite the right role, or the timing isn't right? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll be in touch when something fits: https://nivoda.net/talent-pool

jobs.title: SAP IS-U Consultant Netznutzungsabrechnung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
SAP Consulting · Remote (Deutschland, alle 2 bis 3 Wochen vor Ort in Hannover) · Angestellte/r

SAP IS-U Consultant mit Schwerpunkt Netznutzungsabrechnung (m/w/d), Remote, Vollzeit, ab sofort nach Absprache.

Für unser sympathisches Team suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n deutschsprachige:n SAP IS-U Consultant (m/w/d), die:der ein S/4HANA Utility Transformationsvorhaben bei unserem Kunden mit tiefgreifender Expertise in der IS-U Abrechnung unterstützt, mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf der Netznutzungsabrechnung.

New Monday ist eine Digitalagentur aus Berlin, die zu 100% remote arbeitet. Zu unseren Kunden zählen namhafte Konzerne wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP, Lufthansa uvm. genau wie moderne Start-Ups wie NUMA Stays.

Als Arbeitgeber zeichnen wir uns vor allem durch flache Hierarchien, unser agiles Mindset und einen New Work Approach aus. Alle unsere New Monday Team Members arbeiten zu 100% remote (Home Office), sind dank unserer positiven Remote Culture aber trotzdem miteinander verbunden (erfahre mehr darüber im Abschnitt "Benefits"). Bitte beachte: Für dieses Projekt ist alle 2 bis 3 Wochen eine Präsenz von Dienstag bis Donnerstag beim Kunden in Hannover vorgesehen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung des Projektteams im Rahmen einer S/4HANA Utility Transformation mit Expertise in der SAP IS-U Abrechnung, insbesondere Netznutzungsabrechnung.
  • Analyse bestehender IS-U Systemlandschaften mit umfangreichen Eigenentwicklungen, einschließlich Customizing, BAdIs, Erweiterungen, User-Exits und Z-Logiken.
  • Begleitung von Fit-to-Standard-Workshops und Gap-Analysen sowie Ableitung notwendiger Maßnahmen.
  • Bewertung der optimalen Überführung bestehender Altsysteme in die S/4 Architektur.
  • Frühzeitige Validierung neuer Funktionen, Prozesse und Migrationspfade, idealerweise mit Transformations- oder Sandbox-Systemen.
  • Eigenständige Umsetzung von Customizing-Aufgaben und Hands-on-Bearbeitung direkt im System.
  • Verantwortungsvolle Begleitung sowohl analytischer als auch technischer Umsetzungsschritte.

Qualifikation

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in SAP IS-U Abrechnung mit klarem Schwerpunkt Netznutzungsabrechnung.
  • Erfahrung in S/4 Utility Transformationsprojekten, insbesondere im Kontext Fit-to-Standard und Gap-Analysen.
  • Fähigkeit, bestehende IS-U Systeme mit umfangreichen Eigenentwicklungen zu analysieren, einschließlich Customizing, BAdIs, Erweiterungen und Z-Logiken.
  • Gute Kenntnisse der S/4 Systemlandschaft, idealerweise Erfahrung mit entsprechenden Transformations- oder Sandbox-Systemen.
  • Fähigkeit, Customizing eigenständig umzusetzen und Themen auch hands-on im System zu bearbeiten.
  • Insgesamt eine Hands-on-Mentalität, um sowohl Analyse als auch Umsetzung im System zu begleiten.
  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Projektsprache ist Deutsch).
  • Bereitschaft, alle 2 bis 3 Wochen von Dienstag bis Donnerstag vor Ort in Hannover zu arbeiten.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung im Umfeld Netznutzungsabrechnung in Verbindung mit add-on-basierten Lösungen.

Benefits

  • Tolle Leute, super Atmosphäre, dynamisches Team, agile Arbeitsweise
  • Sweet Spot zwischen Corporate-Alltag und kreativem Agenturleben: Bei uns musst du nicht zwischen hunderten Projekten gleichzeitig jonglieren, sondern bist immer nur für ein einzelnes Projekt eingeteilt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, deutschlandweit ortsunabhängig zu arbeiten, wo immer du möchtest (100% Home Office) sowie im Rahmen der rechtlichen Vorgaben zeitweise auch im EU-Ausland
  • Monatliches Budget für Treffen vor Ort mit deinen Kolleg:innen, das du beliebig einsetzen kannst (Teamtage im Co-Working-Space aber genauso auch einfach für den gemeinsamen Lunch, Dinner, After-Work-Drinks etc.)
  • Regelmäßige digitale Teamabende und andere coole digitale Events
  • Treffen vor Ort mit dem ganzen Team in unserem inoffiziellen Hub Berlin ein- bis zweimal pro Jahr
  • Wöchentliche Learning Sessions im Team und weitere Möglichkeiten zu deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung (Weiterbildungen, Erwerb von Zertifikaten etc.)
  • Eigenständiges, flexibles Arbeiten ohne Micromanagement

Erstes Kennenlernen Du lernst unsere Arbeitsweise und Philosophie kennen. Du hast die Gelegenheit, dich vorzustellen. Wir beantworten alle deine Fragen in entspannter Atmosphäre.

Vorstellungsgespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti Ausführlicheres Kennenlernen. Gelegenheit zu gegenseitigen Fragen.

Follow-Up Hierzu erhältst du vorab eine kleine fachliche Challenge aus der IS-U Praxis, in der du zeigen kannst, wie du an Aufgaben herangehst. Die Ergebnisse besprechen wir gemeinsam im Follow-Up. Du hast anschließend die Möglichkeit, ein Gespräch unter vier Augen mit einem deiner zukünftigen Kolleg:innen zu führen und in vertrauensvoller Atmosphäre all das zu fragen, was dir vielleicht noch auf der Seele brennt.

Also los geht's! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Um es einfach zu halten, verzichten wir gerne auf ein Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, auch wenn du das Gefühl hast, nicht 100 % der Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

New Monday fördert aktiv die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir begrüßen daher alle Bewerber:innen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Identität der Person. Location: Remote (EU based, GMT timezone)

Department: Engineering

Employment Type: Contract (B2B)

Contract Length: 6 months (with potential for extension)

About YLD:

Our goal is to help our clients keep moving forward. We work with them to build the skills and capabilities they need to stay ahead of the competition, and we know our success only happens when they succeed. We’re a team of curious, talented people, and we’re committed to making YLD a place where great people want to work, grow, and stay.

We’re a remote-first consultancy specialising in software engineering, product design, and data. Our teams are based across London, Lisbon, and Porto, and we create digital solutions that continue to deliver value long after our work is done.

About the role:

As a Platform Software Engineer at YLD, you'll be part of a client team, owning cloud access and identity management along with a large part of their infrastructure-as-code. Day to day, that means controlling who and what can do what across their cloud estate, and standing up the newer tooling that sits alongside it. It's shared infrastructure that many teams depend on, so much of the role is careful change management, governance, and unblocking others.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong, hands-on AWS experience, particularly IAM, IAM Identity Center / SSO, and AWS Organizations (essential)
  • Terraform (essential), Terragrunt (strongly preferred)
  • Experience running shared, high-blast-radius infrastructure
  • GitHub Actions for CI/CD, including OIDC federation to cloud providers
  • Familiarity with Datadog, CloudWatch, or similar tooling
  • Some Python or JavaScript for scripting
  • Multi-cloud experience is a plus
  • A strong focus on clean engineering practices, including testing and reliability;
  • Use AI tools to augment your work, applying sound judgement to adopt emerging technologies where they genuinely add value and increase your impact as an engineer.

What you’ll get in return:

  • The chance to work with a forward-thinking, ethical, and fun group of people and to develop and grow your skills in a fast-moving business

Our typical recruitment process:

  • 1st Interview with a Talent Partner (30/45 mins)
  • Technical Interview with our Senior Developers (1h30)
  • Final chat with our Client Partner (30/45 mins)

Get a glimpse of what it's like working at YLD! 🤳

Check out our LinkedIn page

We live and breathe our values, and know you will too:

  • Growing every day
  • Including everyone
  • Relationships built on honesty and ethics
